name: Ancient Forest
text: Dense paths, climbing routes, vine traps, and forest clearings. Unlock camps to reduce the time spent chasing a target across layers.
tip: Use the map’s vertical levels deliberately; a nearby icon may be above or below you.
overview: A beach, tangled understory and immense tree crown share one deeply layered map. Use the floor selector before following an icon: a nearby marker may be several climbs above you, and the upper camps greatly shorten nest visits.

camps.name: Southwest Camp
camps.unlock: Automatic story unlock.

camps.name: Northwest Camp
camps.unlock: Find the site; complete Ancient Forest I delivery.

camps.name: Northeast Camp
camps.unlock: Automatic story unlock.

camps.name: Ancient Forest Camp
camps.unlock: Find the treetop site; complete Ancient Forest II delivery.

gathering.name: Honey
gathering.notes: Combine with Potions for Mega Potions.

gathering.name: Herb
gathering.notes: A quick refill for basic healing.

gathering.name: Blue Mushroom
gathering.notes: Useful for Potions and early supply runs.

gathering.name: Parashroom
gathering.notes: Keep some for Tranq Bomb crafting.

gathering.name: Flashbug
gathering.notes: Craft Flash Pods; resistance limits repeated flashes.

gathering.name: Thunderbug
gathering.notes: Combine with a Trap Tool for Shock Traps.

gathering.name: Mandragora
gathering.notes: Save for Max Potion crafting.

gathering.name: Nulberry
gathering.notes: Useful during elemental-blight hunts.

gathering.name: Ancient Bone / bonepiles
gathering.notes: Bonepile results depend on rank and chance.

gathering.name: Mining outcrops
gathering.notes: LR, HR and MR have different ore pools.

gathering.name: Wyvern Egg
gathering.notes: Fragile carry item; bring it to camp supplies.

routes.title: Supplies before the hunt
steps: Start at Southwest Camp (1); gather the nearby herbs, then visit area 2 for Honey and Parashrooms.
If unlocked, fast-travel to camp 17 for Mandragora and bugs instead of climbing the entire tree.
Store your haul before leaving; this is a resupply plan, not a guaranteed rare-drop loop.

routes.title: Treetop exploration
steps: Start at camp 17 and mark the nest in area 16 on the correct map floor.
Use the upper branches to check the Bugtrappers' trail and nearby gathering pockets.
For egg delivery, clear the route first and remember that carrying an egg prevents fast travel.

secrets.title: Befriend the Bugtrappers
secrets.where: Tree crown near area 17
secrets.how: On a solo expedition with your Palico, gather Grimalkyne traces and follow the marked Bugtrapper through the upper branches to its settlement.
secrets.reward: Flashfly Cage Palico gadget and Bugtrapper friendship.
secrets.conditions: Follow the tribe encounter; unlocking every forest camp is not a separate requirement.

secrets.title: Downy Crake on a living perch
secrets.where: Area 1, on Aptonoth backs
secrets.how: Inspect the herd from a distance. If the tiny white birds appear, approach carefully with the Capture Net ready; a Ghillie Mantle helps avoid disturbing them.
secrets.reward: Rare endemic-life entry and a room pet.
secrets.conditions: Rare random appearance; neither visiting the area nor waiting a fixed time guarantees a spawn.

secrets.title: Moonlit Mushroom pocket
secrets.where: Hidden passage off area 11
secrets.how: Check expedition conditions for Flourishing: Mushrooms. Search west of Northeast Camp through the low passage near the stream and gather the special colony.
secrets.reward: Moonlit Mushroom account item and its canteen ingredient unlock.
secrets.conditions: The unique colony requires the matching flourishing condition; ordinary colonies do not replace it.

secrets.title: The dam above the nest
secrets.where: Area 16
secrets.how: During a suitable fight, break the wooden dam while the monster is in the torrent's path. Large Barrel Bombs can help trigger the environmental opening.
secrets.reward: Environmental damage and a dramatic knockdown below.
secrets.conditions: Requires a monster positioned to be caught by the water; it is not a repeatable gathering node.

quests.name: Fungal Flexin' in the Ancient Forest
quests.unlock: Talk to the Meowscular Chef early in the story; deliver 20 Gourmet Shroomcaps from the quest's gathering nodes.
quests.reward: Adds the Soiled Shroomcap canteen ingredient.

quests.name: Gettin' Yolked in the Forest
quests.unlock: After One for the History Books, speak to the Meowscular Chef; carry two Wyvern Eggs from the area 16 nest to camp.
quests.reward: Adds the Wyvern Egg canteen ingredient.

trivia.title: A tree that distributes water
trivia.text: Rain gathers high in the Ancient Tree, and its branches and roots carry water through the forest. The watery canopy is part of the ecosystem's structure, not just scenery.

trivia.title: The Commission's first foothold
trivia.text: Southwest Camp is identified as the first base camp established on the New World continent.

name: Wildspire Waste
text: Open dunes meet muddy wetlands and underground chambers. Desert charges and muddy armor reward different preparation.
tip: Screamer Pods can create openings against a suitably vulnerable, burrowed Diablos.
overview: The dry dunes and giant spires sit beside surprisingly fertile wetlands. Work the desert and marsh as separate gathering circuits, and use Central Camp or Eastern Camp to avoid crossing the entire region between objectives.

camps.name: Southwest Camp
camps.unlock: Automatic story unlock.

camps.name: Central Camp
camps.unlock: Find the site; complete Wildspire Waste I delivery.

camps.name: Eastern Camp
camps.unlock: Automatic story unlock.

camps.name: Northeast Camp
camps.unlock: Find the site; complete Wildspire Waste II delivery.

gathering.name: Round Cactus / Bauble Cactus
gathering.notes: Gather Round Cactus for the botanical delivery objective.

gathering.name: Honey
gathering.notes: Refill Mega Potion ingredients while changing zones.

gathering.name: Might Seed
gathering.notes: Useful for attack consumables.

gathering.name: Sleep Herb
gathering.notes: Keep alongside Parashrooms for Tranq Bombs.

gathering.name: Parashroom
gathering.notes: A useful early capture-supply pickup.

gathering.name: Flashbug
gathering.notes: Check the upper part of area 5.

gathering.name: Thunderbug
gathering.notes: Refill Shock Trap ingredients.

gathering.name: Nulberry
gathering.notes: Helpful when a hunt inflicts elemental blights.

gathering.name: Boulder Bone / bonepiles
gathering.notes: A possible bonepile result; loot varies by rank.

gathering.name: Mining outcrops
gathering.notes: Follow outcrop icons; rank changes the ore pool.

gathering.name: Herbivore Egg
gathering.notes: Carry carefully for the relevant optional quest.

routes.title: Cactus objective circuit
steps: Choose the Prickly Predicament quest and use its Round Cactus map icons.
Work area 6, then check the neighboring cactus areas if nodes are exhausted.
Gather until the requested Bauble Cactus total is reached; alternate cactus results do not count toward that objective.

routes.title: Capture-supply sweep
steps: Start at Southwest Camp (1) for Honey and Parashrooms, then check area 4 for Sleep Herbs.
If you need bugs, visit upper area 5 for Flashbugs and area 8 for Thunderbugs.
Deposit materials at a convenient unlocked camp rather than carrying a full pouch into another hunt.

secrets.title: The Protectors' missing companions
secrets.where: Northern hideout, approached from the area 15 side
secrets.how: Track the Protectors on a solo expedition. After receiving their request, catch the three marked missing Protectors with the Capture Net and report back.
secrets.reward: Shieldspire Palico gadget and Protector friendship.
secrets.conditions: Bring your Palico; these are capture-net targets, not monsters to fight.

secrets.title: Divineapple above the usual route
secrets.where: Tough-skinned Fruit near the Protectors' hideout by camp 15
secrets.how: Travel from Northeast Camp toward the Grimalkyne settlement and inspect the special fruit node near its entrance.
secrets.reward: Divineapple account item and a canteen ingredient.
secrets.conditions: Requires the matching Flourishing: Tough-skinned Fruit condition.

secrets.title: Downy Crakes among the herd
secrets.where: Areas 1 and 4, on Apceros backs
secrets.how: Check the animals before running into the group. Use the Capture Net if the small white birds appear; approach under a Ghillie Mantle when possible.
secrets.reward: Rare endemic-life collection and a room pet.
secrets.conditions: The birds are rare random spawns and may be absent on repeated visits.

secrets.title: A Noios can change the battlefield
secrets.where: Area 8 above Diablos' underground area 13
secrets.how: When Diablos or Black Diablos is below, provoking a Noios above can draw a burrowing response that collapses the marked ground.
secrets.reward: A natural trap that drags nearby creatures into the chamber below.
secrets.conditions: Requires the appropriate monster position and an unused fissure trap.

quests.name: Prickly Predicament
quests.unlock: After Flying Sparks: Tobi-Kadachi, speak to the Laid-back Botanist; gather 20 Bauble Cactuses in the Waste.
quests.reward: Expands the Botanical Research cultivation list.

quests.name: Royal Relocation
quests.unlock: After One for the History Books, speak to the Laid-back Botanist; hunt the Rathian.
quests.reward: Unlocks further cultivation options, including useful fungi and bugs.

trivia.title: The desert's water comes from elsewhere
trivia.text: The marsh receives water from the Ancient Forest. Those wetlands and the dry spire country support very different animals within one locale.

trivia.title: An apex herbivore
trivia.text: Diablos is territorial rather than predatory: it feeds on cacti despite being one of the Waste's most dangerous residents.

name: Coral Highlands
text: An elevated coral ecosystem with ledges, air currents, and many routes between levels. Watch your footing during airborne encounters.
tip: Carry the correct status answers and plan the route back to a flying target.
overview: Think of this locale as a reef built upward into open air, with caves and gathering shelves beneath the bright upper slopes. Northeast Camp is especially valuable for high-altitude hunts, while the lower areas are better for a relaxed supply-and-fishing circuit.

camps.name: Southern Camp
camps.unlock: Automatic story unlock.

camps.name: Northeast Camp
camps.unlock: Find the site; complete Coral Highlands delivery.

gathering.name: Coral Crystal
gathering.notes: Possible mining result; check rank-specific pools.

gathering.name: Coral Bone
gathering.notes: Possible bonepile result, not a guaranteed drop.

gathering.name: Honey
gathering.notes: A useful healing-supply pickup.

gathering.name: Flashbug
gathering.notes: Refill Flash Pod ingredients.

gathering.name: Thunderbug
gathering.notes: Keep for Shock Trap crafting.

gathering.name: Nulberry
gathering.notes: Useful against Legiana's Iceblight.

gathering.name: Mandragora
gathering.notes: Save for Max Potion crafting.

gathering.name: Spider Web / Ivy
gathering.notes: Collect both for Net crafting.

gathering.name: Parashroom
gathering.notes: Combine with Sleep Herbs for Tranq Bombs.

gathering.name: Goldenfish / Goldenfry
gathering.notes: Check the upper fishing pool.

routes.title: Lower reef supplies
steps: From Southern Camp (1), gather through area 2 and mark the resources you need.
Visit areas 4 and 7 for Flashbugs, or area 6 for web, ivy and mushrooms.
Use the lower fishing pools as a quiet stop before moving upward.

routes.title: Upper shelves and minerals
steps: Start at Northeast Camp (12) and use the floor selector to identify your target outcrops.
Check the upper mining areas and the area 14 supply and fishing pocket.
Keep your route separate from the final climb to area 15 unless the hunt or resource list requires it.

secrets.title: A band behind the waterfall
secrets.where: Troupers' hideout northeast of area 11
secrets.how: During a solo outing with your Palico, repel the mounted Troupers, follow their trail and accept Troubled Troupers. Complete its two-Tzitzi hunt.
secrets.reward: Coral Orchestra Palico gadget, Trouper friendship and Shamos Tailraiders.
secrets.conditions: The tribe encounter and its optional quest are solo steps.

secrets.title: An orange queen after dark
secrets.where: Wiggler groups in areas 1 and 3
secrets.how: Search at night for the orange Wiggler Queen among the ordinary blue animals. Crouch or use a Ghillie Mantle and aim the Capture Net before getting close.
secrets.reward: Rare endemic-life collection and a room pet.
secrets.conditions: Night-only rare appearance; ordinary Wiggler groups do not guarantee a queen.

secrets.title: Violet Abalone in a crawlspace
secrets.where: Area 9, small opening along the coral wall
secrets.how: With Upsurge: Conch Shell active, crawl into the secluded gathering nook and collect its special shell node.
secrets.reward: Violet Abalone account item and a canteen ingredient.
secrets.conditions: Needs the matching upsurge; the normal shell nodes are different.

secrets.title: The treasure trail continues in Iceborne
secrets.where: Troupers' settlement
secrets.how: With Iceborne, raise your unity with the Troupers to level 6, then use Pawswap and trade items to obtain treasure clues.
secrets.reward: Treasure hints and the locale's treasure collection progress.
secrets.conditions: Requires Iceborne and the local tribe friendship; clues are not ordinary gathering drops.

quests.name: Troubled Troupers
quests.unlock: Repel the mounted Troupers and speak to the tribe in its area 11 hideout; accept the solo hunt for two Tzitzi-Ya-Ku.

quests.name: Talons of Ire and Ice
quests.unlock: Complete Persistent Pests and the Elder's Recess expedition, encounter High Rank Legiana and Odogaron, then speak to the Chief Botanist.
quests.reward: A third Botanical Research cultivation slot.

trivia.title: The reef and the graveyard feed each other
trivia.text: Animals drawn to the coral eventually fall into the Rotten Vale. Decomposition below returns nutrients to the Highlands, linking the two spectacularly different landscapes.

trivia.title: Paolumu's floating buffet
trivia.text: Paolumu feeds on land-coral eggs. Its inflatable neck and powerful airflow fit a feeding strategy as well as a fighting style.

name: Rotten Vale
text: Bone fields and lower chambers house scavengers and aggressive predators. Environmental effluvium and monster-inflicted effluvial buildup are separate concerns.
tip: Use the correct protection for the threat; Nulberries answer effluvial health reduction.
overview: The Vale descends from a bone-strewn upper region into effluvium-filled corridors and deeper caverns. Treat your health bar as part of route planning, and separate gathering trips from fights when environmental damage or an aggressive small-monster pack is wearing you down.

camps.name: Southeast Camp
camps.unlock: Automatic story unlock.

camps.name: Central Camp
camps.unlock: Automatic story unlock.

gathering.name: Warped Bone
gathering.notes: Possible bonepile result; rank changes other rewards.

gathering.name: Mining outcrops
gathering.notes: These are useful HR mining areas; MR pools differ.

gathering.name: Mandragora
gathering.notes: Keep for Max Potion crafting.

gathering.name: Honey
gathering.notes: Refill healing ingredients during exploration.

gathering.name: Godbug
gathering.notes: Useful for healing-powder recipes.

gathering.name: Flashbug
gathering.notes: Craft Flash Pods for suitable encounters.

gathering.name: Parashroom
gathering.notes: Keep for Tranq Bomb crafting.

gathering.name: Nitroshroom
gathering.notes: Useful in explosives and combat-item recipes.

gathering.name: Dragonfell Berry
gathering.notes: Keep for Dragon Ammo crafting.

gathering.name: Goldenfish
gathering.notes: A useful fishing detour while checking the depths.

gathering.name: Torch Pod
gathering.notes: Fire at the ground to briefly clear ambient effluvium.

routes.title: Upper bone-and-supply sweep
steps: Start at Southeast Camp (1), checking the bonepiles and nearby mushrooms.
Work the upper bone areas before committing to a descent.
Gathering results vary by rank; rotate between ready nodes rather than expecting a camp visit to reset them.

routes.title: Deep-cavern collection
steps: From Central Camp (11), check the nearby Mandragora and continue toward the lower paths.
Visit area 15 to inspect the Plunderers' pond and nearby rare-life hosts.
Return to camp to store materials; do not linger in damaging mist while managing the inventory.

secrets.title: Feed the Plunderers
secrets.where: Odogaron's den in area 13, then the hideout in area 15
secrets.how: Bring Raw Meat and your Palico on a solo expedition. Follow the Lynian Researcher/Plunderer encounter around Odogaron's stored food; when prompted in area 15, leave the meat and give the tribe space.
secrets.reward: Plunderblade Palico gadget, Plunderer friendship and Girros Tailraiders.
secrets.conditions: Requires access to the lower Vale; the encounter may need another expedition if its participants are absent.

secrets.title: Bristly Crake on a Mosswine
secrets.where: Area 15 is a useful check; Mosswine also occur elsewhere in the Vale
secrets.how: Look at the Mosswine before approaching. If a stiff-feathered bird is riding it, ready the Capture Net and move in carefully under a Ghillie Mantle.
secrets.reward: Rare endemic-life collection and a room pet.
secrets.conditions: Rare random appearance; a Mosswine does not always carry a bird.

secrets.title: The living fossil pond
secrets.where: Area 15, the pond by the Plunderers' settlement
secrets.how: Look for the large dark fish with blue markings and use the Fishing Rod; complete its struggle rather than reeling carelessly.
secrets.reward: Petricanths endemic-life capture and related collection progress.
secrets.conditions: Very rare random spawn; there is another check at Elder's Recess camp 8.

secrets.title: Heavenberry above the side passage
secrets.where: Ledge on the route toward the Plunderers' area
secrets.how: During Upsurge: Crimson Fruit, inspect the vine-accessed ledge before the crawl passage toward the tribe's cavern.
secrets.reward: Heavenberry account item and a canteen ingredient.
secrets.conditions: The unique Crimson Fruit point appears under the matching upsurge.

quests.name: Persistent Pests
quests.unlock: After Radobaan Roadblock and reaching HR8, take the Chief Botanist's request and slay 14 Hornetaur.
quests.reward: A second Botanical Research cultivation slot.

quests.name: The Meat of the Matter
quests.unlock: After Into the Bowels of the Vale, speak to the Meowscular Chef; deliver two Lumps of Meat from the lower Vale.
quests.reward: Adds the Marinated Carpaccio canteen ingredient.

trivia.title: The mist is alive
trivia.text: Effluvium is a bacterial community associated with the Vale's decomposing remains. The place functions as part of the New World's nutrient cycle rather than an abandoned wasteland.

trivia.title: Different problems need different protections
trivia.text: Ambient effluvium chip damage and the health-reducing effluvial status are separate effects. Effluvial Expert and Effluvia Resistance address different parts of that problem.

name: Elder’s Recess
text: Crystal caverns and volcanic areas with powerful late-game targets. Heat protection and terrain awareness make long hunts more manageable.
tip: Restock your heat solution before crossing hot areas and learn the falling-crystal opportunities.
overview: Crystalline halls give way to hot volcanic chambers around the Everstream. Carry Cool Drinks for the hot sections, open the eastern camp early, and check the fishing pond during resupply visits instead of treating every expedition as a straight run to an elder dragon.

camps.name: Southern Camp
camps.unlock: Automatic unlock on reaching the locale.

camps.name: Eastern Camp
camps.unlock: Find the site; complete Elder's Recess I delivery.

camps.name: Northwest Camp
camps.unlock: Reach the hidden site; complete Elder's Recess II delivery.

gathering.name: Fucium Ore
gathering.notes: HR mining result; MR has a different pool.

gathering.name: Firecell Stone
gathering.notes: Possible mining result; not guaranteed per outcrop.

gathering.name: Brutal Bone
gathering.notes: HR bonepile material; check rank-specific pools.

gathering.name: Chillshroom
gathering.notes: Craft Cool Drinks before entering hot chambers.

gathering.name: Honey
gathering.notes: Refill Mega Potion ingredients.

gathering.name: Godbug
gathering.notes: Useful for healing-powder recipes.

gathering.name: Flashbug
gathering.notes: Keep for Flash Pod crafting.

gathering.name: Thunderbug
gathering.notes: Refill Shock Trap ingredients for capturable monsters.

gathering.name: Mandragora
gathering.notes: Useful Max Potion ingredient.

gathering.name: Platinumfish
gathering.notes: Check the water beside Eastern Camp.

gathering.name: Crystalburst
gathering.notes: Grab slinger ammunition before leaving the crystal area.

routes.title: Eastern-camp resupply
steps: Use camp 8 to restock and inspect its fishing pond.
Check the nearby bug, mushroom and honey pickups before leaving the crystal halls.
Gather Chillshrooms if needed, then drink a Cool Drink before committing to the hot sections.

routes.title: Mining with a safe return
steps: Start at an unlocked camp and mark active outcrops in the rank you intend to farm.
Work the crystal and volcanic mining zones listed above, skipping nodes that are not ready.
Return to camp before starting another lap; Geologist improves gathering efficiency without guaranteeing rare results.

secrets.title: Gajalaka night infiltration
secrets.where: Researcher's meeting point in area 8; settlement toward area 16
secrets.how: Befriend the other World tribes, complete the Gajalaka doodle research, then meet the Lynian Researcher at night. Sneak through the guarded route and speak to the leader; a Ghillie Mantle is useful.
secrets.reward: Meowlotov Cocktail, Gajalaka friendship and Gastodon Tailraiders.
secrets.conditions: Requires the Cultural Exchange: Gajalaka Linguistics chain and a solo outing with your Palico.

secrets.title: A living fossil beside a supply tent
secrets.where: Eastern Camp (8), fishing pond
secrets.how: Check the pond for the large blue-marked Petricanths during ordinary resupply stops. Use the Fishing Rod and finish its capture struggle.
secrets.reward: Rare Petricanths capture without a long trip through the Vale.
secrets.conditions: Rare random appearance; the pond is a spawn location, not a guaranteed fish.

secrets.title: Twilight Stone behind the tribe route
secrets.where: Gajalaka settlement watercourse toward Northwest Camp (16)
secrets.how: After befriending the Gajalaka, follow the watercourse toward the camp and inspect the special amber point before the drop.
secrets.reward: Twilight Stone account item and a canteen ingredient.
secrets.conditions: Requires Gajalaka access and Upsurge: Amber Deposits.

secrets.title: Noahstone on a crystal ledge
secrets.where: Crystal ledge reached from the broad crystal area with Gajalaka
secrets.how: With the beryl upsurge active, inspect the side ledge reached by dropping onto the lower crystals; gather its special Beryl Deposit.
secrets.reward: Noahstone account item and a canteen ingredient.
secrets.conditions: Requires Upsurge: Beryl Deposits; do not confuse this with ordinary mining outcrops.

secrets.title: Crystals make an overhead trap
secrets.where: Area 8 crystal battlefield
secrets.how: Lure a monster beneath the hanging crystal formation and hit the formation with slinger ammunition.
secrets.reward: Environmental damage and a knockdown opportunity.
secrets.conditions: Needs the monster beneath an available hanging crystal.

quests.name: Setting Up Camp: Elder's Recess I
quests.unlock: Discover the eastern campsite, then submit 750 Research Points, two Barnos Hide+ and one Monster Bone+ at the Resource Center.
quests.reward: Eastern Camp (8) fast travel and resupply.

quests.name: Setting Up Camp: Elder's Recess II
quests.unlock: Discover the northwest campsite, then submit 1,200 Research Points, one Dodogama Hide+ and two Wingdrake Hide.
quests.reward: Northwest Camp (16) fast travel and resupply.

quests.name: Chef Quest! Gajalaka Lockdown
quests.unlock: After the Elder's Recess expedition, speak to the Meowscular Chef and accept the request to defeat ten Gajalaka.
quests.reward: A new canteen ingredient on first completion.

trivia.title: Crystal halls beside a volcano
trivia.text: The Recess lies directly beside the Everstream. Its enormous pale crystals and molten lower chambers are two faces of the same region.

trivia.title: A roaming link between layers
trivia.text: The developers used Uragaan's movement through the Recess to link its different strata, bringing hunters into contact with other inhabitants while following it.

name: Hoarfrost Reach
text: Iceborne’s new hunting locale stretches from snowy woodland to icy caverns. The environment adds cold management and unfamiliar routes.
tip: Prepare a Hot Drink or suitable protection, and unlock camps as your assignments open more of the map.
overview: Iceborne opens in a broad, layered wilderness where open snowfields sit above warmer caves, fishing pools and hidden climbing routes. Prepare for cold-related stamina loss, establish the optional camps, and treat expeditions as a chance to collect canteen ingredients and endemic life between hunts. The highest ledges reward patient exploration as much as the monster arenas do.
gatheringNote: These are practical gathering targets and confirmed example areas, rather than an exhaustive list of every node. Use the detailed map's gathering filters and check its upper and lower layers.

camps.name: Southern Camp
camps.unlock: Automatic when the story first brings you to Hoarfrost Reach.

camps.name: Western Camp
camps.unlock: Automatic during early Iceborne story progression; no delivery is needed.

camps.name: Central Camp
camps.unlock: Discover the campsite, then complete Setting Up Camp: Hoarfrost Reach I at the Resource Center: 1,000 research points and 1 Tobi-Kadachi Membrane+.

camps.name: Shipwreck Camp
camps.unlock: Automatic through the main story as the northern portion of the locale opens; no delivery is needed.

camps.name: Northeast Camp
camps.unlock: Discover the campsite, then complete Setting Up Camp: Hoarfrost Reach II: 1,200 research points and 1 Azure Rathalos Fellwing.

gathering.name: Hot Pepper
gathering.notes: Turn these into Hot Drinks before crossing exposed snowfields.

gathering.name: Honey
gathering.notes: A useful refill stop for a healing-supply gathering lap.

gathering.name: Nulberry
gathering.notes: Collect near the southern routes before a longer hunt.

gathering.name: Gracium
gathering.notes: Check mining outcrops while moving between camps and caves.

gathering.name: Eltalite Ore
gathering.notes: A common early Master Rank equipment-upgrade resource.

gathering.name: Purecrystal
gathering.notes: A chance-based mining result; repeat a circuit when needed.

gathering.name: Meldspar Ore
gathering.notes: Include this northern area when your recipe needs Meldspar.

gathering.name: Frozen Bone
gathering.notes: Gather from bonepiles while completing a regional materials lap.

gathering.name: Thick Bone
gathering.notes: Shares useful gathering stops with Frozen Bone.

gathering.name: Young Butterburs and Butterbur account items
gathering.type: Butterbur Patch • delivery and canteen gathering
gathering.notes: The southern patches supply Greetings from the Tundra. Rarer Butterbur discoveries unlock canteen ingredients; the unique Snow White patch needs flourishing Butterbur.

gathering.name: Frozen Foliage / Icebloom account items
areas: Frozen Foliage icons across Hoarfrost Reach
gathering.notes: Collect Moonlight and Snowpeak Iceblooms for canteen discoveries. The special Petalcryst node appears during flourishing Frozen Foliage; it rewards Crystal Quaff.

gathering.name: Dragonvein Coal
gathering.notes: Keep coal for the Steamworks in Seliana. Hoarfrost Reach can provide ordinary Dragonvein Coal; the richer Coal Chunk gathering circuit belongs to the Guiding Lands.

routes.title: Southern supplies and the first Harvest Box upgrade
steps: Start at Southern Camp (1), take Hot Pepper, and prepare a Hot Drink before heading farther out.
Visit the Area 2 hot spring and nearby supplies, then sweep the Butterbur Patches in Areas 1, 2, 4 and 5.
If Greetings from the Tundra is active, continue until the quest registers all 20 Young Butterburs.
From Western Camp (5), add bonepiles; once Central Camp (7) is established, use it to reach the mining and lower-cave routes efficiently.
Return through the quest's normal completion flow to claim the Harvest Box upgrade. Keep collected coal for Seliana's Steamworks.

routes.title: A clear-night endemic-life expedition
steps: Prepare the Fishing Rod, Capture Net, Hot Drinks and a Ghillie Mantle. Check that it is night with clear weather before planning the summit visit.
Use Central Camp (7) and a marked drop into Area 8 to check the far underground pond for Sealord's Crestfish.
Fast-travel to Northeast Camp (15), then reach the northern Area 13 climbing entrance with the ceiling Wedge Beetles.
Chain the grapples, climb the ice-wall sections, and use the steam vent to reach the highest route. Watch the ledges rather than jumping off them.
At the Area 14 summit, wait for a spawned Wintermoon Nettle to drift into Capture Net range. Both targets are rare; an eligible visit never guarantees a spawn.

secrets.title: Befriend the Boaboa and earn the Tailraider Signal
secrets.where: Southern Camp (1), the Area 2 Wingdrake route, and the Boaboa hideout in Area 17.
secrets.how: Finish the base-game Lynian gadget friendships, including the Gajalaka, and progress past the Viper Tobi-Kadachi assignment. Talk to the Lynian Researcher, enter a solo expedition, and hunt a large monster while the Boaboa observe. Follow their invitation to the council, then complete By Our Powers Combined.
secrets.reward: Boaboa friendship, the Tailraider Signal tool, and access to the local Raider Ride partnership.
secrets.conditions: Iceborne story progression and the earlier tribe friendships are required. Bring your Palico and complete the introductory expedition solo.

secrets.title: Wintermoon Nettle above the highest ledges
secrets.where: Area 14's mountain summit; the hidden climbing route begins in northern Area 13.
secrets.how: Use the Wedge Beetle chain and ice-wall climbs to reach the summit. Look for the giant floating creature and wait until it enters Capture Net range before firing.
secrets.reward: Wintermoon Nettle for your room and the Celestial Illusion award.
secrets.conditions: Clear nights only, with a rare random spawn. Felyne Zoomaster improves rare-life searching; it does not guarantee the creature.

secrets.title: Sealord's Crestfish in the underground pond
secrets.where: Area 8, the pond at the far end of the chamber across from Viper Tobi-Kadachi's nest.
secrets.how: Visit the lower cave at night and inspect the pool for the long fish with a luminous lure. Use the Fishing Rod; Baitbugs can help attract it.
secrets.reward: Sealord's Crestfish for your room and the Submerged Mystery award.
secrets.conditions: Nighttime and a rare random spawn. A clear-night visit also pairs well with the Wintermoon Nettle route.

secrets.title: A golden visitor to the hot springs
secrets.where: Start with the Area 2 hot spring; Goldspring Macaque habitats also include other Hoarfrost hot springs.
secrets.how: Inspect the central rocks and monkeys from a distance. Approach quietly under the Ghillie Mantle and use the Capture Net when the golden monkey is in range.
secrets.reward: Goldspring Macaque for your room and the Golden Gleam award.
secrets.conditions: Search in clear daylight for a practical repeatable check. This is a rare encounter, and an empty spring is normal.

secrets.title: Snow White on the mountain route
secrets.where: A unique Butterbur Patch at the top of Area 13's mountain obstacle course, among other Butterbur Patches.
secrets.how: Choose an expedition with flourishing Butterbur, complete the hidden climb, and gather the special patch. Return normally so the account-item discovery registers.
secrets.reward: Snow White discovery, unlocking the Entrancing Alembic canteen ingredient.
secrets.conditions: The Butterbur flourishing locale effect must be active; ordinary Butterbur gathering does not replace this special node.

secrets.title: Petalcryst in the lower climbing cave
secrets.where: Lower-layer Area 8, an alcove halfway up the small cave's stair-like climbing slopes.
secrets.how: Check for flourishing Frozen Foliage before departure. Explore the cave alcove that is otherwise empty and gather its special Frozen Foliage node.
secrets.reward: Petalcryst discovery and Crystal Quaff, one ingredient used toward Felyne Zoomaster meals.
secrets.conditions: The Frozen Foliage flourishing locale effect is required for this unique gathering point.

quests.name: Greetings from the Tundra
quests.unlock: Complete Banbaro Blockade, then collect the request in Seliana. Deliver 20 Young Butterburs from the regional gathering patches.
quests.reward: The first completion expands the Botanical Research Harvest Box.

quests.name: By Our Powers Combined
quests.rank: M★2 Optional • MR 3+ entry requirement • solo
quests.unlock: Complete the Cultural Exchange: Hoarfrost Reach introduction and attend the Boaboa council. The Boaboa Commander then gives this Tempered Beotodus hunt.
quests.reward: Completes the Boaboa alliance sequence for Tailraider Signal; also awards Boaboa Tickets.

quests.name: Duet of Rime
quests.unlock: Own and equip the Iceproof Mantle, then speak to the Seliana Armory at the required rank. Hunt Legiana and Shrieking Legiana in Hoarfrost Reach.
quests.reward: First completion upgrades the Iceproof Mantle to Iceproof Mantle+.

trivia.title: Iceborne's largest new wilderness
trivia.text: Capcom introduced Hoarfrost Reach as World's largest locale at the time. Its scale includes the warm caves and high climbing routes, so a flat view of the snowfields misses a large part of the map.

trivia.title: The baths are useful in the field
trivia.text: Natural hot springs such as those in Areas 2 and 6 warm your hunter and aid recovery. Spending time in one also earns Source of Relaxation; they are more than scenery around the macaques.

name: Guiding Lands
text: A connected collection of regions, including volcanic and tundra additions, with region-specific material and monster progression.
tip: Choose the augment material first, then the monster and regional level that supply it.
overview: The Guiding Lands is Iceborne's post-story expedition area, combining several ecosystems into one place for specialized monster materials, gathering resources and equipment upgrades. Monster-region levels change the inhabitants, while mining and bonepile progress follow their own separate meters. Decide which material you need before choosing a region, a node circuit or a monster lure.
gatheringNote: These are selected material targets, not every possible drop or a fixed-coordinate map. Giant nodes guarantee the matching Guiding material; the highest ordinary node tier can also produce it rarely. Gathering tiers are separate from monster-region level 1–7.

camps.name: Western Camp
camps.unlock: Automatic when the post-story expedition first reaches the Guiding Lands.

camps.name: Eastern Camp
camps.unlock: Discover the camp location, then complete Setting Up Camp: Guiding Lands: 1,500 research points, 1 Prosperous Crystal and 3 Heavy Dragonvein Bones. Prosperous Crystal is mined in the Forest region; Heavy Dragonvein Bone comes from suitable large monsters, rather than gathering bonepiles.

gathering.name: Prosperous Crystal
areas: Forest region, especially an Area 6–7 gathering lap
gathering.notes: Develop the mining meter beyond the early tiers. Save one for Eastern Camp; further uses include Friendship Charm IV and layered-armor recipes.

gathering.name: Dragonvein Coal Chunk
areas: Mining outcrops in all six unlocked regions
gathering.notes: A dedicated Steamworks-fuel target. Higher ordinary node tiers offer it; a giant crystal node is for the region's Guiding crystal instead.

gathering.name: Guiding Forest Crystal
gathering.type: Mining • giant Forest outcrop; rare at the highest ordinary tier
gathering.notes: A targeted pick for Friendship Charm V and Rathalos Master Rank layered recipes. Raise the Forest mining meter to create its giant node.

gathering.name: Guiding Forest Dragonbone
gathering.type: Bonepile • giant Forest pile; rare at the highest ordinary tier
gathering.notes: Keep this separate from mined Forest crystals. Used by Nargacuga layered recipes and the Demon Scavenger Pickaxe.

gathering.name: Guiding Wasteland Crystal
gathering.type: Mining • giant Wildspire outcrop; rare at the highest ordinary tier
gathering.notes: A useful pick for Fitness Charm IV, Golden Lunecoil and several Diablos/Glavenus layered recipes.

gathering.name: Guiding Wasteland Dragonbone
gathering.type: Bonepile • giant Wildspire pile; rare at the highest ordinary tier
gathering.notes: Target this for Breaker Charm III, Golden Lunegreaves and Diablos Nero layered recipes.

gathering.name: Guiding Reef Crystal
gathering.type: Mining • giant Coral outcrop; rare at the highest ordinary tier
gathering.notes: Used by Frost Charm V, Silver Solcoil and Death Garon layered recipes. The English material name uses Reef, rather than Coral.

gathering.name: Guiding Reef Dragonbone
gathering.type: Bonepile • giant Coral pile; rare at the highest ordinary tier
gathering.notes: A targeted gathering pick for Awakening Charm III, Silver Solmail and Legia layered recipes; it is a bonepile material.

gathering.name: Guiding Effluvial Crystal
gathering.type: Mining • giant Rotted outcrop; rare at the highest ordinary tier
gathering.notes: Target this crystal for Fury Charm III and Acidic Glavenus or Odogaron β+ layered recipes.

gathering.name: Guiding Rotted Dragonbone
gathering.type: Bonepile • giant Rotted pile; rare at the highest ordinary tier
gathering.notes: Used by Wyrmsbane Charm V and Odogaron α+ layered recipes. Its gathering meter develops independently of Rotted-region monster levels.

gathering.name: Guiding Magma Crystal
gathering.type: Mining • giant Volcanic outcrop; rare at the highest ordinary tier
gathering.notes: Useful for Rath Soul and Uragaan layered recipes. Collect regular Magma/Hellfire materials on the way to the giant outcrop.

gathering.name: Guiding Volcanic Dragonbone
gathering.type: Bonepile • giant Volcanic pile; rare at the highest ordinary tier
gathering.notes: A separate resource from Magma Crystal. Used in Brachydios and Lavasioth Master Rank layered recipes.

gathering.name: Guiding Rime Crystal
gathering.type: Mining • giant Tundra outcrop; rare at the highest ordinary tier
areas: Tundra region after the Stygian Zinogre assignment
gathering.notes: Used for Windproof Charm V and Barioth or Azure Age layered recipes. Tundra is a Guiding Lands region with its own resource meter.

gathering.name: Guiding Tundra Dragonbone
gathering.type: Bonepile • giant Tundra pile; rare at the highest ordinary tier
gathering.notes: A targeted pick for Unscathed Charm III and Shrieking Legia or Tigrex layered recipes. Gather it from bonepiles, not monster carves.

routes.title: A repeatable ore-and-bone lap
steps: Choose a region based on the material in your recipe. Equip gathering comfort such as Geologist and Master Gatherer, plus a Ghillie Mantle.
Begin with Forest Areas 6–7 if you need the second camp's Prosperous Crystal; otherwise start beside your target region.
Check the region's possible node positions around the walls and paths. Nodes appear at a selection of those positions, so one empty spot does not end the circuit.
Gather both mining outcrops and bonepiles until their separate meters develop. When the giant-node notice appears, search the same region for that special node.
Rotate through a neighboring region while resources return, then repeat. Volcanic Areas 14–15 make another compact target after their unlock.
Return to camp to unload and resupply. Fix monster-region levels beforehand if you want to preserve your hunting setup; fixing those levels is separate from gathering-node progression.

routes.title: Farm a specific monster material with fewer wasted spawns
steps: Start at the Smithy recipe and identify whether the missing item is an ore, a gathered bone, a normal monster material or a tempered monster material.
Check the region-level requirement and complete the MR 49, 69 or 99 gate if it blocks that target. Turn Fix Region Levels off only while intentionally raising the needed region.
Once the region is ready, fix its levels if you want to preserve them. Obtain a matching lure through special-track analysis or the Elder Melder's available Guiding Alchemy recipes.
Ask the Handler to lure the monster into a compatible region. Confirm its tempered status before committing to a tempered-material farm.
Collect dropped materials, break parts, and hunt or capture as appropriate; Elder Dragons must be slain. Report expedition results to the Handler and resupply between targets.

Gather the required regional ore or bonepile material during the same visit. A tempered-monster drop and a giant gathering-node material can belong to the same recipe but come from different activities.

secrets.title: Three progression bars with different jobs
secrets.where: The region information and resource meters in the Guiding Lands map/Hunter's Notes.
secrets.how: Hunts and associated research develop monster-region levels. Gathering develops that region's mining and bonepile meters separately. Fill a resource meter to create its giant node, claim the matching rare material, then continue the gathering cycle.
secrets.reward: Control over rare ores and gathered bones without confusing their requirements with high-level monster spawns.
secrets.conditions: A region does not need monster level 7 to produce its giant gathering nodes. Resource availability still depends on unlocking the region itself.

secrets.title: Protect a useful region setup before joining friends
secrets.where: Fix Region Levels in the Guiding Lands departure/settings options.
secrets.how: Turn on the actual Fix Region Levels setting when you want your current region levels preserved, including in another player's expedition. Turn it off when intentionally leveling. Choose a clear expedition objective so other hunters understand the plan.
secrets.reward: A stable setup for repeated targets instead of accidental changes while helping another group.
secrets.conditions: Raising one region can reduce others, so building every region together is inefficient. The searchable Fixed Region expedition objective is only a label; it does not switch the level lock on. Each player's lock applies personally.

secrets.title: Make a lure instead of waiting for a random appearance
secrets.where: The Handler in camp and Guiding Alchemy at the Elder Melder.
secrets.how: Analyze special tracks earned during expeditions, or exchange suitable monster parts for available Special Tracks through Guiding Alchemy. Use the resulting lure with the Handler and choose a compatible region.
secrets.reward: A direct attempt at the monster needed for your next equipment upgrade.
secrets.conditions: A lure is consumable. The region and its level still control the appropriate spawn and tempered state; a lure does not bypass those requirements.

secrets.title: Tempered materials are a monster hunt, not a mining tier
secrets.where: The chosen monster's Guiding Lands appearance; for example, Tempered Namielle in a developed Coral region.
secrets.how: Check the exact material name, lure the correct monster and verify that it is tempered. Collect its dropped materials and hunt rewards. Tempered Trancehide is a Tempered Namielle material, while Great Spiritvein Gems come from eligible high-threat tempered monsters.
secrets.reward: Monster-specific upgrade materials that gathering circuits cannot substitute for.
secrets.conditions: Normal and tempered forms have different material pools. Heavy Dragonvein Bone also belongs to suitable monster rewards, despite having Bone in its name; it is not the same as a gathered Guiding Dragonbone.

secrets.title: Moly watching during a quiet gathering visit
secrets.where: Regular Moly colonies include Forest Areas 6–7; each ecosystem has its own possible colony sites.
secrets.how: Approach in a Ghillie Mantle with the Capture Net ready. Revisit colony sites between gathering laps and look for a distinctive regional animal among the ordinary Moly, such as the green-tufted Mossy Moly.
secrets.reward: Room pets and progress toward the Deft Digger and Creatures of the Earth awards.
secrets.conditions: Regional rare variants require that region to be level 5 or higher. Their appearance is still random; a colony is not guaranteed on every visit.

secrets.title: The map has two post-launch extensions
secrets.where: The Volcanic and Tundra regions of the Guiding Lands.
secrets.how: After finishing Iceborne's story, follow the purple Special Assignment prompts through the Rajang investigation for the Volcanic region. The later Stygian Zinogre assignment, Across the Lost Path, opens the Tundra route.
secrets.reward: Two additional ecosystems, their mining and bonepile materials, and new monster appearances.
secrets.conditions: Simply reaching the original four-region Guiding Lands does not finish these unlock chains. Their new gathering resources are distinct from the ordinary Elder's Recess and Hoarfrost Reach resources.

quests.name: Sleep Now in the Fire
quests.unlock: Reach MR 49 and speak to the Field Team Leader. Hunt Tempered Rathian and Tempered Nightshade Paolumu in the Ancient Forest; this is a Guiding Lands progression gate even though the hunt takes place elsewhere.
quests.reward: Raises the MR cap to 69 and permits Guiding Lands region level 5.

quests.name: Big Burly Bash
quests.unlock: After the earlier cap quest, reach MR 69 and speak to the Field Team Leader. Hunt Tempered Brachydios and Tempered Glavenus in the Elder's Recess. If the request is absent, continue regional progression and check the NPC again.
quests.reward: Raises the MR cap to 99 and permits Guiding Lands region level 6.

quests.name: To the Very Ends with You
quests.unlock: Reach MR 99 and a cumulative total of at least 12 Guiding Lands region levels, then speak to the Field Team Leader. Slay Ruiner Nergigante in the Guiding Lands.
quests.reward: Removes the final progression cap on Master Rank and permits region level 7; subsequent progression can reach MR 100+.

trivia.title: A map that grew with the title updates
trivia.text: Launch-era guides show four ecosystems. Rajang's update added the Volcanic region, and the Stygian Zinogre update added Tundra, which explains why older screenshots omit part of the modern map.

trivia.title: Gathering also feeds the fashion collection
trivia.text: The rare Guiding crystals and bones appear in matching crystal-pendant recipes as well as equipment recipes. Collecting each region's special node materials can therefore expand both your upgrade options and your cosmetic choices.
